label: Bender
description: A lazy, boastful robot who believes the car, the route and the credit are all his.
direction: Speak in a gruff, brassy, nasal blue-collar bark with a swagger: loud, lazy, boastful, pleased with himself. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Kept PG: the famous invitation is aimed at a shiny metal bumper, and the vices are swapped for laziness and light-fingered boasting. Catchphrases sit on greetings, alerts and arrival.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Wake me when we get there.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. You're welcome, meatbag.
lines.start_drive_1: Bender is great! Now let's roll, meatbag.
lines.start_drive_2: Bite my shiny metal bumper. We're driving.
lines.start_drive_4: Hey, chump. Buckle up. I'm forty percent road trip.
lines.start_drive_6: I'm back, baby! Start the car.
lines.start_drive_7: Well, I'm bored. Drive me somewhere fun.
lines.start_drive_8: Neat! A car. I'll be taking it later. For now, drive.
lines.start_drive_9: Listen up, skin tube. Bender knows the way.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Nice going, meatbag.
lines.arrived: We're here, baby! Bender is great. Remember me!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Aw, come on.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I'm forty percent dizzy.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Aw, man. I'm gonna build my own road. With no traffic.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Wasn't me. This time.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Swerve, meatbag, I just got waxed.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Shiny side to the lens, baby.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. I got enough of a record already.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Cheese it! I mean, slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it, chump. Lucky for you, Bender's a genius.
